name: Italian Cream
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: small tea-cups full of water
ingredients.originalText: four small tea-cups full of water

instructions.text: Put two pints of cream into two bowls.
With one bowl mix six ounces of powdered loaf-sugar, the juice of two large lemons, and two glasses of white wine.
Add the other pint of cream, and stir the whole very hard.
Boil two ounces of isinglass with four small tea-cups full of water, till it is reduced to one half.
Stir the isinglass lukewarm into the other ingredients, and put them into a glass dish to congeal.

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put two pints of cream into two bowls.
2. With one bowl mix six ounces of powdered loaf-sugar, the juice of two large lemons, and two glasses of white wine.
3. Add the other pint of cream, and stir the whole very hard.
4. Boil two ounces of isinglass with four small tea-cups full of water, till it is reduced to one half.
5. Stir the isinglass lukewarm into the other ingredients, and put them into a glass dish to congeal.
